Done — one execution, passed all checks.

`out/T3/solution.py` reads the input in header order, drops the 48 attention buffers (`bias`/`masked_bias`/`rotary_emb.inv_freq`), casts the 64 anchored projection matrices to bfloat16 and everything else to float32, asserts the four required checks before writing, then greedily packs into 9 shards under the 256 MiB budget and writes `model.safetensors.index.json`.

Result: 196 tensors, 64 bfloat16, 2,436,513,792 bytes; `embed_out.weight` and `gpt_neox.embed_in.weight` each sit alone in their own shard. `out/T3/REPORT.md` is written.
